text: Add rate limiting to our API so a single client can't hammer the /search endpoint.
Let me check config.py first to see the existing settings pattern.
Config is a plain class. I'll add RATE_LIMIT_DEFAULT and per-route overrides here.
No middleware module exists yet, so I'll create middleware.py with a RateLimiter class that reads config.py's overrides.
middleware.py needs to be wired in, so I'll edit routes.py to call RateLimiter.allow() before the /search handler.
routes.py references a shared rate_limiter that doesn't exist yet — instantiate it in app_init.py with the other singletons.
Adding a test that hits /search past the limit and expects a 429.
